name: @saizul/result-kit
description: Tiny, tree-shakable Result<T, E> and Option<T> for TypeScript: map, andThen, match, unwrapOr, ResultAsync for promises, tryCatch, fromPromise, all/any/combine, typed error unions, safeTry generators, and safeFetch/safeJsonParse helpers. Zero dependencies.
author: Saizul Amin (https://github.com/saizul)

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint src test test-d scripts examples && npm run typecheck && npm run test:types
scripts.format: biome format --write src test test-d scripts examples
scripts.format:check: biome format src test test-d scripts examples
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run test:types && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
